item.g:title: Pip
item.g:description: Solid bronze, small enough to vanish into a closed fist, with an ombré patina. Proximity induces unexpected calm; scholars remain blissfully baffled. The patina is built up slowly by hand and deepens wherever the thumb rests.

item.g:title: Rebi
item.g:description: Solid bronze with an ombré patina, and a different outline from every side of the room. Handling is known to sharpen the reflexes; owners report catching things before they fall. Each plane is refined by hand after casting.

item.g:title: Ren
item.g:description: Solid bronze with a bright crest, drawn from a painted toy on a Swedish shelf. Dawn light lingers on it longer than it should; hikers report arriving home early. The crest is polished by hand while the body is left to darken.

item.g:title: Zuma
item.g:description: Pocket-sized solid bronze, drawn at the same table as its namesake ring. Ancient runes suggest the two belong together; kept apart, both grow restless. Its sun-worn surface is filed and patinated by hand.

item.g:title: Ori
item.g:description: Broad, round-shouldered solid bronze that sits heavy and quiet in the palm. Each winter solstice it gives off a faint warmth; keepers report fewer drafts. Its wide planes are smoothed and patinated slowly by hand.

item.g:title: Yaël
item.g:description: Slender solid bronze, balanced on the narrowest of footings. Altar bells resonate in its presence; neighbors report faint chimes at dusk. Its fine upper curves are refined patiently by hand after casting.

item.g:title: Milo
item.g:description: The first piece made to carry the Maçon mark, in solid bronze with an ombré patina. Its surface adapts to whoever holds it; the bond deepens every season. Each Milo is worked by hand until its surface turns quiet.

item.g:title: Ibi
item.g:description: Tall, still solid bronze with a long and patient posture. Attempts to photograph it end in lens fog; photographers blame the weather. Cast on request and patinated by hand.

item.g:title: Eleph
item.g:description: Heavy and rounded, with an ombré patina, caught halfway through a long exhale. A low, distant call has been reported by independent observers, always just out of sight. Cast on request and finished entirely by hand.

item.g:title: Zuma Ring (5.5)
item.g:description: Sterling silver carrying the shoulder line of the Zuma totem around the finger. Unearthed glyphs record rituals performed with its pair; wearers report an urge to walk barefoot. Each band is sized and polished by hand.

item.g:title: Ida's Wonder Horn
item.g:description: A silver spiral on a thirty inch chain, after the instrument Ida played until the goblins danced out the window. Nearby children develop perfect pitch; lab equipment hums along. Its inner curl is filed and polished by hand.

item.g:title: Starship Key
item.g:description: Chrome-bright sterling silver on a thirty inch chain, shaped like a key to something far above. Prolonged exposure causes wanderlust; researchers take long sabbaticals abroad. Its hull is polished meticulously by hand.
